tagline.en: A controllable world model built on NVIDIA's efficient Sana architecture, for camera-driven video generation.
tagline.zh: 构建于英伟达高效 Sana 架构之上的可控世界模型，用于相机驱动的视频生成。

en: SANA-WM is a world model for controllable video generation, built on NVIDIA's Sana architecture — a family known for efficient high-resolution image synthesis. It generates video you can steer with a camera path, keeping the scene coherent as the viewpoint moves.

It reuses the canonical Sana network, encoder, autoencoder, and scheduler, and runs as a resident two-stage pipeline: a bidirectional stage followed by an LTX-2 refiner. It advances the scene in native temporal windows and renders at 1280×704, and WorldFoundry can partition its components — the stage-one model, refiner, refiner text encoder, VAE, and camera intrinsics — across multiple GPUs.
In WorldFoundry you run SANA-WM through its resident pipeline: provide the conditioning and camera control, and it generates the corresponding video.
zh: SANA-WM 是一个用于可控视频生成的世界模型，构建在英伟达的 Sana 架构之上——该家族以高效的高分辨率图像合成而知名。它生成的视频可用相机轨迹引导，在视角移动时保持场景连贯。
它复用了标准的 Sana 网络、编码器、自动编码器与调度器，以常驻的两阶段 pipeline 运行：一个双向阶段，后接一个 LTX-2 精炼器。它以原生时间窗口推进场景，渲染分辨率为 1280×704；WorldFoundry 可把它的各组件——第一阶段模型、精炼器、精炼器文本编码器、VAE 与相机内参——分布到多张 GPU 上。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过它的常驻 pipeline 运行 SANA-WM：提供条件与相机控制，它便生成相应的视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a controllable, camera-driven world model on the efficient Sana architecture, with a refiner stage for quality and multi-GPU component placement for larger runs.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个基于高效 Sana 架构、相机驱动的可控世界模型，带有精炼阶段提升质量、并支持多卡组件分布以应对更大规模运行时使用。

notFor.en: It runs as a multi-GPU resident pipeline, so it expects adequate hardware. The checkpoint must be staged locally before use.
notFor.zh: 它以多卡常驻 pipeline 运行，需具备足够硬件。使用前 checkpoint 需放到本地。

en: Controllable world model on NVIDIA's Sana architecture
Two-stage resident pipeline with a bidirectional stage plus LTX-2 refiner
Multi-GPU component placement for larger runs
zh: 基于英伟达 Sana 架构的可控世界模型
两阶段常驻 pipeline：双向阶段加 LTX-2 精炼器
相机可控的视频生成，分辨率 1280×704
